t: A small free speech synthesizer that reads text aloud in over 100 languages.
steps: Find the eSpeak NG project page.
Ask IT to install a package for your operating system.
Open a terminal and run espeak-ng with a short sentence.
Test a second language with the voice option.
Try an app that already bundles eSpeak NG for easier use.
Stay online during install. Check offline use, which the research did not confirm.
Share a short sheet of commands with students.
